name: qa-automation-playwright-ts
description: TypeScript-based Playwright + Cucumber automation framework for login validation.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/support/**/*.ts --require src/step_definitions/**/*.ts --format progress --format html:reports/cucumber-report.html --format json:reports/cucumber-report.json --retry 1 --retry-tag-filter "@flaky" features/**/*.feature
scripts.test:admin: npm run typecheck && cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/support/**/*.ts --require src/step_definitions/**/*.ts features/ui/admin/login.feature
scripts.test:smoke: npm run typecheck && cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/support/**/*.ts --require src/step_definitions/**/*.ts --tags "@smoke" --format progress --format html:reports/cucumber-report.html --format json:reports/cucumber-report.json features/**/*.feature
scripts.test:sanity: npm run typecheck && cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/support/**/*.ts --require src/step_definitions/**/*.ts --tags "@sanity" --format progress --format html:reports/cucumber-report.html --format json:reports/cucumber-report.json features/**/*.feature
scripts.test:regression: npm run typecheck && cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/support/**/*.ts --require src/step_definitions/**/*.ts --tags "@regression" --format progress --format html:reports/cucumber-report.html --format json:reports/cucumber-report.json features/**/*.feature
scripts.test:headed: npm run typecheck && cross-env HEADLESS=false cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/support/**/*.ts --require src/step_definitions/**/*.ts --format progress --format html:reports/cucumber-report.html --format json:reports/cucumber-report.json features/**/*.feature
scripts.test:parallel: npm run typecheck && cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/support/**/*.ts --require src/step_definitions/**/*.ts --parallel 4 --format progress --format html:reports/cucumber-report.html --format json:reports/cucumber-report.json features/**/*.feature
scripts.test:retry: npm run typecheck && cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/support/**/*.ts --require src/step_definitions/**/*.ts --retry 2 --format progress --format html:reports/cucumber-report.html --format json:reports/cucumber-report.json features/**/*.feature
scripts.test:ci: npm run typecheck && cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/support/**/*.ts --require src/step_definitions/**/*.ts --format json:reports/cucumber-report-ci.json features/**/*.feature
scripts.test:tag: npm run typecheck && cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/support/**/*.ts --require src/step_definitions/**/*.ts --format progress --format html:reports/cucumber-report.html --format json:reports/cucumber-report.json --tags
